concept.name: Long short-term memory network
concept.definition: A gated recurrent neural network whose cell state and input, forget, and output gates regulate information retention across long sequences.
concept.intuition: It is a learnable mapping or representation used to turn features into predictions or groups.
concept.mechanics: At each time step compute gate values, update the cell state from retained and candidate information, then expose a gated hidden state.
concept.formula: c_t = f_t c_(t-1) + i_t g_t; h_t = o_t tanh(c_t)
concept.failure_modes: Flexible models can fit noise, shift under new regimes, and conceal instability when tuning is repeated on the same validation data.
concept.misconceptions: Greater model complexity or in-sample accuracy does not by itself imply better out-of-sample trading results.
concept.example: An LSTM reads 60 daily feature vectors and uses its final hidden state to forecast the next five-day return.
